runners.comment: December's AW win brings him into the picture; two defeats in January need leaving behind
runners.spotlight: 13th time lucky when winning a 9.4f handicap at Wolverhampton in December; not so good twice in January and now returns from an 11-week break; Oisin Murphy booked so a better showing would seem likely.

runners.comment: Promise in two course runs; had wind op since last seen; may come on for this reappearance
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; finished second in her two course runs as a 2yo; well handicapped on last season's best and she has undergone wind surgery during her 176-day absence; should be winning races this year but this perhaps not the day to catch her.

runners.comment: Not shone in two runs for new stable; dropped to a dangerous mark but not a solid option
runners.spotlight: Won an 8.3f handicap at Nottingham last May when rated 6lb higher; two low-key runs for his new stable in February, refusing to settle in first-time blinkers at Newcastle in February (slowly-run race); others appeal more for win purposes.

quotes.race: Download The Raceday Ready App EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D, No More Than 3 Runs) (GBB)
quotes.quote: Mini Mac loves the soft ground but hated the track. Had it been a more conventional course he'd have won it more cosily - Billy Loughnane, jockey.

runners.comment: Unplaced in two runs for new stable last month; new headgear; stamina not assured
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f for Martin Dunne in the second half of 2025; unplaced in two 7f handicaps on Tapeta for new stable last month; new headgear added today; stamina for 1m still to be proven.

runners.comment: Signs of a revival when fifth at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last month; on a dangerous mark now
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress for Ed Walker and she was well beaten on her stable debut in February; last month's staying-on fifth at Wolverhampton (8.6f) was more like it though and she needs a close look off her lowly mark.

runners.comment: Improving run by run but another step forward is required now switched to turf
runners.spotlight: Improving his RPR run by run and he was placed for the first time when third of eight at Lingfield (1m, AW) five weeks ago; could have more to offer after just five starts but he doesn't look the easiest of rides.

runners.breeder: Dr Caroline Scott & Mr Ron Spore
runners.comment: Two wins last year included one over C&D; absent 117 days; stable also run Dashing Donkey
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in a C&D handicap (good to soft) last July and she added an AW success to her tally in September; not handicapped out of things now returning from 117 days off; stable also run Dashing Donkey.

runners.comment: Two 7f wins here in 2022; running well in defeat on AW this year; each-way shout
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f here in 2022; in good form on AW this year and likely to give his running once again; each-way shout.

runners.comment: On a winning mark and not beaten far on AW latest; looked a hard ride there though
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f handicap at Leicester last May off this mark; close fourth at Kempton 17 days ago where she hung markedly right up the home straight; easy lead unlikely today.

racecards.verdict: Merapi, The Spotlight Kid and No Knee Never (second choice) can go well but THE UBERMENSCH (nap) appeals most.
racecards.betting_forecast: 11/4 The Ubermensch, 6/1 No Knee Never, 10/1 Dashing Donkey,  South Kensington,  The Spotlight Kid, 12/1 Moonlight Bomb,  Borderline Madness, 14/1 Devious Devan,  Potters Prince,  Grand Citadel, 16/1 Le Pelerin,  Queen Of Good News,  Merapi, 25/1 Mini Mac, 33/1 Miss Monte Carlo

racecards.race_name: TigerBet.co.uk National Extra Places Paid Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Narrow win in a 1m AW novice in January; tough task conceding weight all round today
runners.spotlight: Benefited from the runner-up hanging sharply left when the narrow winner of a 1m novice at Southwell in January; that form hasn't really worked out and, while he is open to improvement and 1m2f should suit, he faces a tough task under a penalty today.

runners.comment: Third in 1m2f Group 3 when last seen; unexposed at the trip and sets a high standard
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in three 1m novice/maiden runs but showed high level of ability; improved for the step up to 1m2f when finishing third of eight in the Group 3 Zetland Stakes at Newmarket when last seen; should have no difficulty winning a novice and he sets a high standard for his rivals to aim at.

runners.comment: Half-brother to three winners, notably Group 3 scorer Marquisat (RPR 118); yard going well
runners.spotlight: 170,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to three winners including Marquisat (7.5f-12.4f including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 118) and Luisa Casati (1m2f AW/1m4f turf Listed; 104); dam unraced half-sister to 1m4f Listed winning dam of 1m/1m1f Group 1 winner Dreamloper; stable going well and he needs a market check.

runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen
runners.comment: First foal of a Listed-placed 1m2f winner; market useful on debut
runners.spotlight: First foal of a Listed-placed 1m2f winner (RPR 102), herself a sister to 1m-1m4f winner Educator; appealing pedigree and market confidence would look significant.

runners.comment: Two promising AW runs at around 1m; more to come but such progress is essential
runners.spotlight: Two promising runs on AW at around 1m; open to improvement but it will be needed if he is to lower the colours of Del Maro.

racecards.verdict: Although DEL MARO was expensive to follow as a 2yo, he ran to a high level in defeat and can make a winning reappearance.
racecards.betting_forecast: 5/6 Del Maro, 7/2 Point Of Law, 6/1 Sintra, 8/1 Knowledge, 10/1 Florentine Law

racecards.race_name: TigerBet.co.uk Fast Sign Up Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Made a winning debut (1m, AW) in January; new trip a positive; penalty demands more
runners.spotlight: Justified short-priced favouritism to win a 1m fillies' novice at Southwell on New Year's Day; new trip will suit judged on her stout pedigree; no easy task under a penalty though.

stable_tour.quote: This is the most expensive horse we've ever been sent - she cost ?550,000, which smashes our previous record by about double. She's a beautiful Sea The Stars filly. She'd be a middle-distance type for three and four and as you can probably tell from the price tag she's very good looking and takes the eye. We haven't pressed any buttons yet, although we're not too far from doing so. 09-07-25

runners.comment: Second and first in two 2yo runs; step up in trip a plus; open to further progress
runners.spotlight: Green when second of eight in a 7f fillies' maiden at Newmarket last September; didn't need to improve to win a 1m event here one month later; should relish today's extra distance and she's a key player despite a 7lb penalty.

quotes.race: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
quotes.quote: I didn't want to be in front really, I was happy when something gave me a lead. Ottoman Empress travelled up nicely, she got a little bit lost when I first went for her but her last half a furlong was the best - Billy Loughnane, jockey, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

runners.comment: Green when last of five here (1m) last October; bred to leave that well behind this year
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience when last of five in a 1m fillies' novice (good) here in October; this 925,000gns yearling is bred for middle distances and she should leave that initial effort well behind her this year.

runners.comment: 3,000gns yearling; dam a minor 6f winner; looks an unlikely winner
runners.spotlight: 3,000gns yearling; second foal of a minor 6f winner (RPR 55); she would be a surprise winner on debut.

runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
runners.comment: Fair 3rd in a steadily-run 7f maiden (soft) on debut last October; bred to do much better
runners.spotlight: Top-class pedigree and she was sent off favourite for her Doncaster debut last October (7f, soft), eventually finishing third of the six runners in a steadily run affair; open to improvement over this longer trip/faster ground.

runners.comment: Two encouraging runs last October; step up to 1m2f should suit; others have achieved more
runners.spotlight: Promising debut at Nottingham (8.3f, good to soft) last October; beaten even-money favourite at Newcastle later that month but still ran a creditable race; out of an Oaks winner so stepping up in trip looks a good move; improvement is essential all the same.

runners.comment: First foal of a Group 1 winner in Germany; Oaks entrant; a newcomer of some interest
runners.spotlight: First foal of a 1m2f/1m4f winner in Germany (including Group 1; RPR 112); holds an Oaks entry; represents a leading stable and the betting should be revealing.

runners.comment: 2.9m gns yearling; fine pedigree and has some fancy entries; starts out in a warm novice
runners.spotlight: 2,900,000gns yearling; first foal of a Group-placed 7f 2yo winner (RPR 102), herself a half-sister to multiple Group 1 winner Luxembourg; has some fancy entries but she is starting out in a warm novice.

runners.comment: Promising debut in January (1m, AW) but she's in a warmer race and looks vulnerable
runners.spotlight: She made an encouraging start to her career when fifth of 13 in a 1m fillies' maiden at Kempton in January; today's longer trip will suit but this looks a tough race.

racecards.verdict: A good race in which the promising OTTOMAN EMPRESS can come out on top. Bintsaleh heads a long list of dangers.
racecards.betting_forecast: 5/2 Ottoman Empress, 4/1 I'm The One, 6/1 Bint Kilfrush,  Harriet Quimby,  Maldives, 7/1 Bintsaleh, 8/1 Harper Violet, 20/1 Premier Cru, 100/1 Emerald Reine

racecards.race_name: Ma And Pa Peak Birthday Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Bumper winner; won 1m4f AW maiden in December; down in trip but now switched to a handicap
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in September who won a 1m4f AW maiden at Wolverhampton in December; not so good at Kempton (1m3f) since and there's a further drop in trip today but the return to turf could suit now switched to a handicap; yard also runs Shihoku.

stable_tour.quote: He got off the mark in a Sedgefield bumper last month and will now go novice hurdling. He wants nice, spring ground and he works very well at home. He's schooled nicely as well and we'll look to run him before the ground turns, but I think he will be a nice horse in the spring. 24-10-25

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras D'Haspel
runners.comment: Won AW maiden in France last spring; up and down over range of trips for this yard
runners.spotlight: Won AW maiden (about 1m1f) in France last spring; rather up and down over a range of trips for this yard, albeit this is easier than the two turf handicaps contested in Britain; hood refitted; reservations remain.

runners.comment: Some promise for R Varian; kept on to lead close home on handicap/yard debut (1m4f, AW)
runners.spotlight: Some promise at 1m2f in four starts for Roger Varian and he made a terrific start for this yard when persevering well to lead close home on Lingfield AW (1m4f) on recent handicap debut; up 3lb and this galloping track should suit now back at 1m2f; good claims.

runners.comment: Won first 2 handicaps at 1m2f; beaten in better races since; off since July; check betting
runners.spotlight: Improved to win first two handicaps at about 1m2f, at Chester and Salisbury (good to firm and good), and later defeats came in higher grades than this; off since July; market can guide as to expectations today.

stable_tour.quote: We hope she might be next year's Cheshire Dancer. She's been looking like she wants to grow all year and there's every reason to believe she should improve. With the amount of changing she might potentially do, there's really that scope for her to improve. She's a fast-ground filly. 08-10-25

runners.comment: Both wins at 1m2f, latest last April; consistent after but below best on soft in September
runners.spotlight: Both wins at 1m2f (good to soft and good), the latest at Haydock last April; consistent in defeat in the second half of 2025 until below best on soft ground here (about 1m3f) in September; thereabouts on best form.

runners.comment: Won fair 1m2f Wetherby handicap last spring for W Knight; lesser runs since; new yard
runners.spotlight: Galloped on strongly when winning one of just two 1m2f handicaps for William Knight, at Wetherby (good to firm) last spring but later forays into Listed company didn't go well and nor did the return to handicaps on final two starts last year; still of interest back on turf for new yard.

runners.comment: 0-14 but involved in some tight finishes at 1m; seemed to stay 1m2f on final start
runners.spotlight: A maiden after 14 starts but he's been involved in some tight finishes at 1m and didn't seem to be lacking in the stamina department when third of ten over this new 1m2f trip at Redcar (good to soft) in September; that may give him some new options but he probably needs more, even so.

runners.comment: Three 1m4f wins on AW and turf; good second on AW latest; can go well back on turf
runners.spotlight: Three front-running wins at 1m4f, on AW and turf (good to soft; effective on good), but he doesn't have to lead, as shown when held up before having a tight passage behind an improver at Kempton (1m3f) in February; rare to see him over 1m2f but he has a good run in him back on turf.

runners.owner: John & Peter Seabrook And Tim Fisher
runners.comment: Two 1m2f wins at Sandown (good and soft) last summer; well below best in 2 of 3 runs since
runners.spotlight: Successful in first two starts after cheekpieces were refitted, at Sandown (1m2f; good and soft) last summer, but his form went to pot in two of three runs after; needs to return in much better form.

quotes.race: Ron And Esther Leahy Memorial Handicap
quotes.quote: I think the application of cheekpieces and the step up to ten furlongs has helped Beach Point. His brother improved for doing exactly the same and I'd been wanting to do it for the last couple of runs. I think he had his right conditions today and Callum gave him a lovely ride. We'll freshen him up now but I'd like to think he'd be a horse on the upgrade - William Knight, trainer.

runners.comment: Course winner; irregular form in 2025 but he went close on reappearance off 4lb lower
runners.spotlight: Course winner who had irregular form in 2025 but he only just failed on his reappearance at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last spring and he's 4lb lower now; on the cards that he'll return with a good effort.

stable_tour.quote: He has now won four of his 12 races, including last time out at Windsor earlier this month. I sent him there thinking he should be competitive but I was pleasantly surprised how easily he won. The handicapper has not been too harsh, rising him 8lb to a mark of 88 and you would hope he can win again off that. He has clearly improved from last season and this big scopey individual could have more to offer. All being well he runs next week Windsor, again over 1m2f but in a Class 3 this time. 25-05-22

prev_owners.owner: A J McNamee & L C McNamee

runners.comment: Won first 3 handicaps for this yard (1m-1m2f) but up weights and needs to show he can cope
runners.spotlight: Won first three handicaps for new yard on AW and turf (1m-1m2f) by emphatic margins but he couldn't defy a penalty in October and was a further 5lb higher when soundly beaten in November; now has to show he can cope with current mark; regular cheekpieces left off.

quotes.race: Parkfield Equine Solutions Handicap
quotes.quote: When Alice [Bond, jockey] took Mc'ted so wide, I wasn't sure it was the right thing to do, but then I saw he was in front and thought 'fair play, she knows what she's doing'. I was delighted as there looked to be a bit more pace on paper here. We've loose-schooled him, just messing around and playing with him a bit, and maybe the change of scenery has sparked him up. Either way, he's in great form and, thankfully, he's winning for us - Martin Dunne, trainer.

runners.breeder: Floors Stud Ltd & The Duke Of Devonshire
runners.comment: Some promise in qualifying runs; low-key handicap form but return to turf could suit
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in qualifying runs at up to 1m2f; has yet to distinguish himself in handicaps but the ground was soft in his one attempt at this level on turf and perhaps he'll do better back on good ground.

runners.comment: Two staying AW wins last winter; has won over hurdles since; work to do over 1m2f
runners.spotlight: Two staying wins on AW last winter and has since won over hurdles but he was tailed off in the latter discipline when last seen in October and, reappearing over 1m2f, others are higher up the list.

quotes.race: Build Your Acca With BetUK Handicap
quotes.quote: I watched back Currumbin's last few races and it just looks like he stays. Today he relaxed beautifully, he took me there very comfortably and he won well - Kieren Shoemark, jockey, speaking to Sky Sports Racing.

racecards.verdict: A few to consider but SOMETHING is back on his winning turf mark in 2025 and shaped nicely from off the pace on the AW last time.
racecards.betting_forecast: 9/2 Siouxfonic, 5/1 Yaa Min, 13/2 A Major Payne,  Something, 7/1 Patagonia Girl, 8/1 Salamanca City, 10/1 Bintabuha,  Beach Point, 14/1 Shihoku,  Silver Gunn, 20/1 Desert Heart, 25/1 Mc'ted,  Currumbin

racecards.race_name: In Memory Of Roger Clarke - Vet Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Overcame inexperience to beat Generic by a head on last month's debut (1m, AW); contender
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience but kept on well to collar Generic close home at Kempton 17 days ago (1m); sent off favourite there so a big run was clearly expected; not weighted to confirm those placings but a key player all the same.

runners.comment: Second run better than his debut (both 1m, AW); has more to offer now switched to turf
runners.spotlight: His second run was better than his debut (both 1m on Lingfield's AW track) and he still looked in need of the experience when third last month; can step forward again now switched to turf.

runners.comment: Second, beaten a head, by Enemy Agent on debut 17 days ago (1m, AW); 7lb better off today
runners.spotlight: Travelled better than Enemy Agent but was unable to repel his late thrust in a 1m Kempton maiden 17 days ago; has a 7lb turnaround for that head defeat today and may b able to reverse the placings.

runners.comment: Placed in two 7f runs in February; steps up in trip with further progress possible
runners.spotlight: Two 7f runs in February, improving at the second time of asking; another similar step forward for the extra furlong would see him on the premises.

runners.comment: Promising 2nd on Kempton debut (1m); open to improvement and more appealing than many
runners.spotlight: Attracted support on his Kempton debut in December (1m) and ran well for a close second of the ten runners; can do better and he is more appealing than many.

runners.comment: RPR in the low 70s in two 7f AW runs; bred to appreciate the extra furlong
runners.spotlight: He has shaped with promise in two 7f AW events this year and he is bred to appreciate the step up in trip; each-way shout if improving for 1m.

runners.comment: Two 7f runs at Southwell last year were encouraging but he'll need much more to take this
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise in his two 7f runs at Southwell last October; the extra furlong and switch to turf will need to have a positive effect if he is to take this though.

runners.comment: Modest form in two Chelmsford novice events last year; been gelded; improvement essential
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two Chelmsford novice events as a 2yo (7f/1m); gelded since latest; improvement essential now switched to turf.

runners.comment: £42,000 half-sister to two winners; worth a market check with good claimer booked
runners.spotlight: £42,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Roman Spring (5f/6f including AW; RPR 76) and Only In Jakarta (7f AW; 76); dam unraced half-sister to 5f Listed winner Swiss Lake; worth a market check with Jack Callan taking off a useful 5lb.

runners.comment: 45,000gns yearling; bred for further and perhaps a longer-term prospect
runners.spotlight: 45,000gns yearling; first foal of a maiden sister to a US 1m3f Grade 2 winner; might find this trip on the sharp side on debut.

runners.comment: 1,000gns yearling; half-sister to three winners; likely best watched on debut
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Wheal Kitty (1m; RPR 67), Kasino (6f AW 2yo; 57) and Frasard (US 1m1f turf); useful standard to aim at and likely best watched.

runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners out of a 1m4f AW winner; tough enough task on debut
runners.spotlight: 2,500gns foal; third foal; half-sister to winners Charming Whisper (7f-1m2f including 2yo; RPR 87) and Mister Phoenix (German 8.7f); dam 1m4f AW winner (74); she will need to be useful to make a winning debut.

racecards.verdict: Plenty of possibles in a competitive novice. AL MASLOOL should have more to offer and is tentatively preferred to My Mate Roger.
racecards.betting_forecast: 3/1 Generic, 4/1 Enemy Agent, 5/1 My Mate Roger, 6/1 Al Maslool, 8/1 Master Of Keraunos, 10/1 Thunderhoof, 12/1 Strong Voice, 14/1 Sierra Sue, 16/1 Sharp Romance, 20/1 Whole Lotta Rosie, 33/1 Timely Salute,  Mokata

racecards.race_name: TigerBet.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.owner: Gee Gees Racing, P Gleeson & N Barnes
runners.comment: Well held in a French maiden and a maiden hurdle; sold £1,800 since latest; opposable
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a 1m1f maiden in France (for Andre Fabre); beaten 28l in a Huntingdon maiden hurdle for Jamie Snowden last month; sold for £1,800 since; best watched on stable debut.

runners.comment: Quickened smartly to win by daylight at Southwell (7f) on debut; plenty more to come
runners.spotlight: Sent off the 11-10f for his Southwell debut (7f) in November and his supporters had few concerns as he travelled well prior to surging clear, despite evident inexperience, in the final furlong; looked a colt of considerable promise on that occasion and he holds strong claims under a penalty.

quotes.race: Bet £10 Get £40 With BetMGM EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: It was hard not to be impressed. It's Organise's first day at school and it's hard to know what to expect, and he was pretty raw in the paddock, but once I was up on him he was quite professional. In the race he was a bit reactive, he didn't know whether to take a hold or drop the bridle throughout, but once we got balanced up in the straight he quickened up smartly and just ran green in the final furlong. He's learned loads today and hopefully he can be quite smart - James Doyle, jockey.

runners.comment: Made most when winning over 1m at Newcastle in February; this is tougher under a penalty
runners.spotlight: Dictated a steady pace when winning a 1m maiden at Newcastle in February; showed a willing attitude there but he will need to raise his game if he is to defy a penalty.

runners.comment: Made all for ready 7f win here last October (2nd run); more to come this year; now hooded
runners.spotlight: Confirmed the promise of his Kempton debut last September (7f) when readily making all over 7f here one month later (Pentonville 5.75l back in fifth); 1m should suit and he commands plenty of respect; hooded first time.

runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
runners.comment: Promise in his two starts, the latest last month, but this race demands a good deal more
runners.spotlight: Behind Ya Karim here (7f, good) on sole 2yo start; similar form when third past the post (promoted to second) at Kempton last month; improvement required.

runners.comment: 200,000gns yearling; half-brother to 2 winners in the US; has a useful standard to aim at
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to US winners Astroturf (1m-8.5f AW/dirt) and Kintra (5f turf 2yo); unraced dam closely related to 1m winner Encompassing; has a useful standard to aim at on debut but still worth a market check.

racecards.verdict: Ya Karim is promising but ORGANISE's debut win smacked of star quality and he can defy a penalty before his sights are raised.
racecards.betting_forecast: 8/11 Organise, 7/2 Ya Karim, 7/1 Outback Heat, 8/1 Weheedd, 10/1 Pentonville, 50/1 Hengest

prev_owners.owner: Michael Iavarone & Julia Iavarone & Michael O'Callaghan

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but he may find this an insufficient test these days; blinkers return
runners.spotlight: Now 14lb lower than when a fine second at Epsom on Derby day last June (6f, soft); in and out since then but no doubt he has the ability to feature at 0-80 level if on one of his good days; suspicion he needs slower ground to be a potent force at an easy 5f though; blinkers back on today.

quotes.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Abergwaun Stakes (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: It's a very sharp five at Tipperary, hence the headgear, but it kept Twilight Jet concentrated. We'd lots of dreams and aspirations after he won the Lacken but  he was very sick after Ascot, then had colic surgery since and later slipped on a hard surface so needed surgery on his hock. This year was race to race so and he had a good blow afterwards. The headgear may stay on. He could go to Newbury or further afield in the coming months and may stay in training - Michael O'Callaghan, trainer.

quotes.race: Goffs Lacken Stakes (Group 3)
quotes.quote: Twilight Jet doesn't know when to stop. He's a very good horse. He's as tough. He got better and quicker with every run. He went to the Breeders Cup and that might have been one race too many for him. He's come back bigger and stronger this year and even quicker I think. He's the real deal - Leigh Roche, jockey.

quotes.race: Newmarket Academy Godolphin Beacon Project Cornwallis Stakes (Group 3)
quotes.quote: The plan was to make the running but we got a nice lead into it and the race couldn't have gone any better. Twilight Jet has plenty of speed and handled the drop back to five. He liked this ground but is quite versatile in that regard - Leigh Roche, rider.

runners.comment: Comes here on the back of a last-gasp Newcastle success (5f) last month; respected up 2lb
runners.spotlight: Both her wins have come on AW, the latest when hugging the stands' rail and leading in the last stride at Newcastle (5f; blanket finish) two weeks ago, but she has run well on turf too; 2lb rise for last time shouldn't prevent another good run.

runners.comment: Winless in 2025 but retained his ability; returns off dangerous mark with his yard in form
runners.spotlight: Drew a blank in 2025 but there were some good runs in defeat and he starts this season off an 8lb lower mark than for last year's reappearance; solid third in one run at Yarmouth; best on good ground or faster; makes his seasonal return with a hood back on and with his stable in good form.

quotes.race: bettingsites.co.uk Betting Sites Handicap
quotes.quote: Brave Nation has been in great shape. He ran well here two starts ago and ran a great race again at Sandown last time. He's got a lot of natural speed and hopefully he can start to climb back up the ranks - Billy Loughnane, rider.

stable_tour.quote: He's going to run at Doncaster on Saturday. He loves that track for some reason and he's had three wins and a second from five starts there, all over 5f. Hopefully he can keep up his good record. 09-06-25

runners.comment: Ex-Hong Kong; gambled on at Southwell in February & shaped with some promise; interesting
runners.spotlight: 6f winner in Hong Kong (good ground); absent for 429 days prior to his British debut at Southwell seven weeks ago, a race where he was heavily backed but missed the break and then took a fierce hold through the early part of the race; he kept on nicely at the finish with that in mind and he looks a strong contender back on turf.

runners.comment: String of good AW runs this winter; 8lb lower than for latest turf run; should go well
runners.spotlight: Ultra-reliable operator on AW, running another solid race when second to a class-dropper at Wolverhampton (5f; first time visor) last month; lesser strike-rate on turf but he is fully effective on it and he has been given a real chance by the handicapper, dropped 10lb for his last two turf defeats (in Class 3); should go well.

quotes.race: Esprit Couture 1er Cru Handicap
quotes.quote: Almaty Star has been a bit of a revelation since dropping him back to five and using those forcing tactics. Ray has given him quite an intelligent ride. He stacked them up and got them all caught on heels - Robert Cowell, trainer, speaking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: Good record over C&D; did best of the far-side group at Doncaster last time; contender
runners.spotlight: She was returning from a five-month break when finishing in midfield at Doncaster 13 days ago (5f, good to soft), a race where she tired in the final furlong but still did best of the far-side group; two wins and two seconds from her six C&D runs and she has solid claims off a fair mark.

quotes.race: Unison Supporting Black Workers Handicap
quotes.quote: I was a little bit concerned because Thunder Star is such a strong traveller, but she kept it going and it has opened doors as she's quite versatile with ground - Jessica Macey, trainer.

runners.comment: Outpaced early but ran on well to win at Chelmsford on stable debut; this is a better race
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for her new connections when coming home 2.25l clear of her rivals in a Class 5 at Chelmsford 16 days ago (5f); she looked to be going nowhere through the first half of that race, under the pump before the field had completed a furlong, but the pace folded and she was strong at the finish; a 6lb rise and stronger opposition could find her out.

stable_tour.quote: She was a bucking bronco first time out at Sandown but then ran a really good race to be fourth at Kempton. She goes to Nottingham for a 5f maiden on Thursday and Tom is convinced she's a nice filly. He did a great job for us with Roman Mist a couple of years ago. 02-08-24

racecards.verdict: Golden Long should be winning races soon but ALMATY STAR is down in class on his return to turf and may be able to dominate.
racecards.betting_forecast: 3/1 Golden Long, 7/2 Pixie Diva, 5/1 Brave Nation,  Almaty Star, 11/2 Thunder Star, 8/1 Skellig Isle, 12/1 Twilight Jet

runners.comment: Closest to first win over 6f on AW; hampered in running over 1m latest; bred to do better
runners.spotlight: Out of half-sister to Accidental Agent whose fine career for the yard included a Group 1 at 1m; came nearest to a win when losing out narrowly on Kempton AW (6f) in November but his first 1m run, there in March, promised more as he had anything but a clear run; can do better as 3yo.

runners.owner: The Old Etonian Racing Syndicate II
runners.comment: Creditable handicap runs at 6f/7f; four siblings won at 1m-1m4f so new trip could suit
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on turf debut (heavy); has raced on AW since, not having the cleanest of runs when a keeping-on third at Wolverhampton (7f) in January; four siblings won at between 1m and 1m4f and he looks ready for a go at 1m; shortlisted.

runners.breeder: N Hartery & Lope De Vega Syndicate
runners.comment: Minor form at 7f/1m; gelded since; should find this level more suitable; check market
runners.spotlight: Minor form in 7f and 1m events as 2yo but gelded since and his pedigree suggests the return to this trip should suit, as will the switch to handicap company; interesting to see how the betting goes.

runners.comment: Keeping-on 3rd at Kempton (7f); worth another go at 1m now trying her luck in a handicap
runners.spotlight: Failed to find much when returned to 1m on Chelmsford AW in February but the two immediately in front of her won their next two races and she'd earlier come home nicely to finish a never-nearer third at Kempton (7f); should be competitive back on turf now handicapping.

runners.breeder: Haras D'La Riviere, Mme Liza Judd
runners.comment: Minor promise at 7f/6f as 2yo, blinkered twice (now hooded); may do better at this level
runners.spotlight: Minor promise in 7f and 6f novice events on AW as 2yo (blinkers on last two starts, now replaced with a hood); gelded since; something new may dawn now switched to a more suitable level.

runners.comment: Little to latch on to in three runs at 7f/1m but has a modest mark and O Murphy rides
runners.spotlight: Little to latch on to in three runs at 7f and 1m (hood added latest, now discarded) but her opening mark is modest and Oisin Murphy, who used to have a fair record for the yard, has his first ride for them since 2023.

runners.comment: Not had much luck in latest two handicaps at 1m on AW; now switches to turf
runners.spotlight: Three handicap runs on AW, not getting much luck in either of the last two at about this trip; may be a bit better than her current mark if handling turf at the first attempt and taking well to the added cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Up 2lb for narrow Wolverhampton win over 1m; still time for her to do better back on turf
runners.spotlight: Saddle slipped two starts ago but she had made an encouraging handicap debut for new yard previously and improved on it when just holding the runner-up at Wolverhampton (also about 1m) in March; up 2lb but still time for her to do better if as effective back on turf.

racecards.verdict: The betting should be helpful in this 3yo handicap. STATION BAR is taken to confirm the AW promise of his first run over 1m.
racecards.betting_forecast: 11/4 Station Bar, 5/1 Zoustellar, 11/2 Time To Sparkle, 13/2 Blue Celestial,  Lady Vanguard, 7/1 Slack Bob, 9/1 Sports Day,  Phantom Shadow

racecards.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden

runners.comment: Has shown nothing at Dundalk and the Curragh in three starts; hood goes on now
runners.spotlight: Lost ground at the start when finishing last and only 6-1 for Dundalk debut; well beaten at that track and the Curragh since; hooded now.

runners.comment: Sent off 150-1 and no impression on Curragh debut a fortnight ago; needs more time; gelded
runners.spotlight: Sent off 150-1 and made no impression on Curragh debut a fortnight ago; will need more time; gelded.

runners.comment: Good debut second; keen when third over 1m2f at Navan; big player down in trip
runners.spotlight: Excellent effort on debut at Leopardstown (7f, yielding to soft) in October when beaten 0.75l into second; raced keenly and in front over 1f out when run out of things late on at Navan (1m2f, heavy) 12 days ago, finishing third; speedily-bred so big player down in trip.

runners.comment: Third behind a potentially smart type on debut at Dundalk; will need to improve but could
runners.spotlight: Decent pedigree and encouraging debut third behind a potentially smart type at Dundalk (1m) in February; raced freely on that occasion and will have to take a step forward to take this.

runners.comment: Outran huge odds at Dundalk on debut after a slow break; could run a big race
runners.spotlight: Cheap purchase but outran 150-1 odds when seventh of 14 on 1m Dundalk debut last month, beaten around 7l after a slow break; stable among the winners and he could run a big race if he gets away on terms.

runners.comment: Beaten 11l on 1m Navan debut; his pedigree suggests he may need further in time
runners.spotlight: Fair sixth of 15 on 1m Navan debut 12 days ago when sent off 80-1, but was beaten 11l; his pedigree suggests he may need further in time.

runners.comment: Repeat of his Listed effort at Tipperary would be good enough but the ground is a worry
runners.spotlight: Best effort a close third in Listed heat at Tipperary (7.5f, good; dual Group 1 runner-up Brussels second); poor effort next time on soft at Roscommon; gelded ahead of 7f Dundalk maiden third in October; sets the standard but needs to prove he handles slower conditions on return.

runners.breeder: Mrs T Stack And Mrs Jane Rowlinson
runners.comment: Some okay form in big fields to date but might be one for handicaps in due course
runners.spotlight: From the family of Classic winner Tarascon; started slowly in 7f Galway maiden on only start at two; didn't see out the mile in testing conditions when sixth of 23 at the Curragh on return; solid fifth of 13 there over 7f on latest; cheekpieces.

runners.comment: 1,500euros yearling; half-sister to 5f-7f winner Silver Service (inc 2yo; RPR 94)
runners.spotlight: Third foal; 1,500euros yearling; half-sister to 5f-7f winner Silver Service (inc 2yo; RPR 94); dam 6f winner (73), out of French Listed-placed 1m winner; hooded; best watched.

runners.comment: Tailed off last on Cork debut over 5f last summer; speedily-bred so trip is a big doubt
runners.spotlight: Tailed off last on Cork debut over 5f last summer; speedily-bred filly so this trip is a big doubt.

runners.comment: Bought for 140,000gns after debut second; big run at Galway when last seen; chance
runners.spotlight: Second in 7f Leopardstown fillies' maiden (soft) on only start for Jim Bolger; following month bought for 140,000gns; failed to run to expectations at Dundalk on yard debut but split Ballydoyle pair at Galway (8.5f, soft to heavy) in October; big player.

runners.comment: Okay AW runs; bred for sprint trips but stable in fine fettle at present; market can guide
runners.spotlight: Ran out of steam in closing stages both times Dundalk over 7f; bred for sprint trips but stable in fine fettle at present; market can guide on turf debut.

runners.comment: Big prices and never involved in two AW maidens; safe to rule out on this occasion
runners.spotlight: Big prices and never involved in two AW maidens; safe to rule out on this occasion.

runners.comment: Still early days for top stable but would need to see market support to be of interest
runners.spotlight: Minor promise on Gowran debut (8.5f, heavy) in October but failed to build on that over 7f at Dundalk in January; still early days for top stable but would need to see market support to be of interest.

racecards.verdict: A decent maiden to kick off the card and Joseph O'Brien's FLAWLESS FUSION should prove too strong for her rivals on return
racecards.betting_forecast: 6/4 Flawless Fusion, 4/1 Suspicious Mindz,  Karrygrant, 9/1 New Radical, 10/1 Templenoe, 14/1 Gold Inn, 16/1 Queen Earthlight, 25/1 Prince Andorra, 33/1 Priorstown,  Borora Aura,  Dixie Doodle, 40/1 Halon Bay, 150/1 Emily's Boy,  Perggosa

runners.comment: Handles an ease in the ground and was second off current mark at Sligo last summer
runners.spotlight: Consistent form in defeat in seven turf runs before running no race on AW debut at Dundalk in October; handles an ease in the ground and was second off current mark at Sligo last summer; first try at 1m but should stay.

runners.comment: Hasn't shown a great deal in maidens or a handicap; blinkers go on now
runners.spotlight: Ran three times at Dundalk at two; dwelt at start when down the field on turf/handicap debut at Navan (1m2f, heavy) after being gelded 12 days ago; blinkers are reached for now.

runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Mrs A M O'Brien
runners.comment: Half-sister to Dewhurst winner Beethoven could prove a different proposition now on turf
runners.spotlight: Some okay efforts in three Dundalk maidens before creditable third there on handicap debut last month; half-sister to Dewhurst winner Beethoven could prove a different proposition now on turf; respected.

runners.comment: Showed ability first two AW starts but below that last time; turf/handicap debut
runners.spotlight: Three AW runs at Dundalk; ran green on debut; distant runner-up behind warm favourite on second start; weak in the betting when well beaten last time; market will reveal expectations on turf/handicap debut.

runners.comment: Pair of no-shows since joining this yard; looked a non-stayer in two 7f attempts
runners.spotlight: Navan winner off 61 in October for Mick Mulvany (6f, yielding); pair of no-shows since joining this yard; looked a non-stayer in two 7f attempts; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Second in C&D maiden last July; disappointing in two handicaps; new yard; hooded
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in all four maidens, including when runner-up over C&D last July; disappointing in two handicaps when at the head of the market; hooded on return; first start for new yard.

runners.comment: 6th in Naas fillies' maiden over 5f last July but beaten out of sight in 4 handicaps since
runners.spotlight: Best run when staying-on sixth in Naas fillies' maiden over 5f last July but beaten out of sight in four handicaps since; upped in trip now.

runners.comment: Well-backed for handicap debut at Gowran on Wednesday when respectable 2.5l fourth
runners.spotlight: Didn't show a whole lot in three maidens but well-backed for handicap debut at Gowran on Wednesday when respectable 2.5l fourth of 10 (7f, soft); turned out quickly off same mark; in the mix.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten in trio of maidens at Navan/Dundalk over 5f-7f; market will provide clues
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; long odds and soundly beaten in trio of maidens at Navan/Dundalk over 5f-7f; market will provide clues on her handicap debut.

runners.comment: One place behind Personified latest; each-way candidate if he can take a step forward
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten all four nursery runs; best of two Dundalk runs was on latest when fourth over 1m, one place behind Personified; blinkers now; each-way candidate if he can take a step forward.

runners.comment: Fourth in Gowran claimer (1m, soft) on Wednesday; market can separate yard's runners
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; ran well on first two nursery outings last year; never a factor on 1m2f return at Navan; beaten 1.75l into fourth in Gowran claimer (1m, soft) on Wednesday; market can separate yard's runners.

runners.owner: E D Delany & Mrs Lisa Delany
runners.comment: Fly-leapt the stalls on Dundalk return so that effort easily forgiven but the jury is out
runners.spotlight: Down the field in turf/AW maidens last year; best handicap effort in November when not beaten far into sixth at Dundalk (6f); fly-leapt the stalls on Dundalk return ten days ago so that effort easily forgiven, but the jury is out up in trip; 1lb wrong.

runners.comment: Third on nursery debut over 5f at Naas in September but way below that since; 4lb wrong
runners.spotlight: Third runner for yard; best run when third on nursery debut over 5f at Naas in September but way below that since; needs to get back on track up in trip; seasonal debut; 4lb wrong.

racecards.verdict: PERSONIFIED is a half-sister to the top-class Beethoven and there's every chance she could improve dramatically for the switch to turf
racecards.betting_forecast: 3/1 Personified, 9/2 Nephin Mountain, 11/2 Elly Bay, 7/1 Spirit Honour, 10/1 Gold Find,  Elora Prince, 12/1 Glamazon,  Balance Of Trade, 14/1 The Love Machine, 20/1 Dervo Annie, 25/1 Dream Legend,  Imnotleavinyou, 50/1 Smart Sioux

runners.comment: 2lb below sole turf win, handles an ease, this trip may just stretch his stamina
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner is 1-19 on turf; is 2lb below that last turf win which came at Naas (5f, good) in May 2024; handles an ease but this trip may just stretch his stamina.

quotes.race: Floodlit Fridays At Dundalk Handicap
quotes.quote: Mehman has been very consistent and he was in top shape. He popped nice and clean and it set up nicely - Declan McDonogh, jockey.

quotes.race: Danny Trundle Heating & Plumbing Handicap
quotes.quote: Shane did well to get through plenty of traffic and he said that's his ground. We'll probably go back to the Curragh and find a nice sprint for Mehman - Ger O'Leary, trainer.

quotes.race: Happy New Year From Dundalk Stadium Handicap
quotes.quote: Mehman is a horse we've always loved, he shows a lot of class and speed. He could well be better than this grade but he is so big that he has just needed time. He could be kept on the go - Adrian Joyce, assistant trainer.

runners.comment: Two-time winner in Britain, bought for 10,000gns in Oct', check market
runners.spotlight: Won twice for James Ferguson last year, including once on turf at Nottingham (8.5f, good) off 9lb lower; picked up at the sales in October for 10,000gns and worth a market check on first start for Ciaran Murphy.

runners.comment: Won at Laytown in Sept', poor form since, off since Dec', best turf form on good ground
runners.spotlight: Gained breakthrough win on the beach at Laytown (7f) last September; below best in two spins over hurdles and over 10.5f at Dundalk in three starts since; off since December and best form is on good ground.

runners.comment: Two-time AW winner, below best on previous turf runs on easy ground, others preferred
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner is 0-5 on turf; fairly well beaten in both turf handicap runs on easy ground and is 10lb above his last AW win; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Good effort on h'cap debut last Oct', excuses for poor run on return, capable of better
runners.spotlight: Signed off last season with a promising run behind this year's Irish Lincoln winner Ribee at Gowran (7f, heavy); had an excuse when bombing out at the Curragh on seasonal return when the 9-2 favourite (grazed the inside and outside left hock); capable of better.

runners.owner: Nigel O'Hare & Martin W White & Mark Devlin & C G Bryson

prev_owners.owner: Nigel O'Hare/Martin W White/Mark Devlin/Rockview Stables

runners.comment: Won off 6lb lower penultimate, beaten off revised mark latest, bit to prove back on turf
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner in February off 6lb lower on second start for this stable; has run well on good to soft so should handle conditions, but came up short off revised mark at Dundalk latest so a bit to prove off this rating.

runners.comment: Consistent in handicaps, ran well when last seen at Dundalk in Dec', yard in hot form
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut off 6lb lower at Thurles last October; backed that up with a decent third at Leopardstown  (7f, heavy) later that month and another solid run at Dundalk (10.5f) in December; returns with yard in red-hot form and ground fine; chance.

runners.comment: Three-time turf winner, likes an ease, has had a spin at Dundalk, each-way chance
runners.spotlight: Three-time turf winner who appreciates an ease in the ground; 5lb above his last success in September at Roscommon (7.5f, soft) but has run well here before and had a recent run at Dundalk so he'll be fit; each-way shout.

runners.comment: Well treated on best British form, last in four runs for this yard, hard to fancy
runners.spotlight: Won four times for Ian Williams on a variety of ground, all at 1m2f; well treated on that form but he's failed to beat a rival home in four runs for this stable; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: 6lb below last win, beaten over 9l in two runs this term, not dismissed
runners.spotlight: Won off 6lb higher in first-time cheekpieces at the Curragh last March (1m, soft); no joy since and beaten around 9l in both starts at that venue this season; blinkers back on instead of cheekpieces; not discounted.

runners.comment: 0-8, hinted he needed further than 1m2f last season, drop in trip a query here; blinkered
runners.spotlight: 0-8 and yet to trouble the judge but has shown glimmers of ability; hinted more than once last season that he needed further than 1m2f but weakened over that trip on return at Navan last month; blinkers now go on, but this trip is a query.

runners.comment: Maiden is 0-5 on turf, best run came on AW, new headgear needs to spark something
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden is 0-5 on the grass and yet to finish in the first three; best run came at Dundalk and hopes are pinned on the new headgear combination sparking improvement.

runners.comment: No joy since 2024 Cork win, 6f too sharp latest, on dangerous mark if rediscovers best
runners.spotlight: No success since winning well at Cork (7f, heavy) in March 2024; shaped well at Down Royal last May and 6f was too sharp on first run back at Navan last month; on a dangerous mark if rediscovers best with blinkers back on.

quotes.race: Buy Annual Membership Today Handicap
quotes.quote: Uncle Albert worked very well during the week. He is tough and genuine and loves that ground. There could be a nice pot to be won with him, although he is ground dependent - Kieran Cotter, trainer

runners.comment: Maiden, placed over C&D last October, might need this run after break
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-15 on turf; has placed twice with one of those efforts a 5.25l third over C&D (soft) last October; 9lb out of the handicap and might need this run after 155 days off.

racecards.verdict: The consistent QUEEN AETHELFLAED lacks a recent run but her yard is flying and ran well off this mark when last seen at Dundalk
racecards.betting_forecast: 7/2 Queen Aethelflaed, 6/1 Kakori, 13/2 Summer Island, 7/1 Bay Of Dreams, 15/2 Goldrush Kid, 8/1 Kevin The Great, 9/1 Mehman, 10/1 Uncle Albert, 12/1 Lahore Da King, 14/1 Selective Power, 20/1 Suerte, 25/1 Lohengrin, 33/1 Romantic War, 50/1 Giselles Defence

runners.comment: AW winner, good run on return at Dundalk from poor draw, handles an ease, go well
runners.spotlight: AW winner ran a fine race from a wide draw on seasonal return at Dundalk (5f) 10 days ago (Jazzit 0.75l behind); handles an ease and should go well again off the same mark.

runners.comment: AW winner off 13lb lower, struggled on return to turf at Navan, may be on tough mark
runners.spotlight: AW winner off 13lb lower; hiked up 12lb for close second in Dundalk claimer in February; struggled off revised rating on return to turf at Navan latest; has run well here before but may be on tough mark for now.

runners.comment: 0-8 on AW, not far behind Jordan Breeze latest, drawn widest for turf debut
runners.spotlight: 0-8 with all starts coming on AW; best run since joining this yard on latest when third at Dundalk; closely matched with Jordan Breeze on that run but drawn widest of all here for turf debut.

runners.comment: 6f win at Navan latest (heavy), up 9lb but rider takes off 3lb, draw could've been kinder
runners.spotlight: Return to turf saw him shed the maiden tag in decisive fashion at Navan (6f, heavy) last month; 9lb rise partially negated by rider's 3lb claim; should be fine dropped to 5f but draw could have been kinder.

prev_owners.owner: Mrs H Mannion, B Carter & F Durbin

runners.comment: Veteran, 13lb below last win, has C&D form, ground fine, can't discount
runners.spotlight: Likeable veteran won for the fourteenth time at Musselburgh (5f, good) last April and is 13lb lower now; showed some spark when a 2l fourth at Dundalk on penultimate and was third over this C&D (soft) off 5lb higher in October; can't discount.

quotes.race: Sky Bet Acca Freeze Handicap
quotes.quote: We had this planned a long way out and we had the best jockey in the north of Britain on - he doesn't panic. We were going to retire Only Spoofing last year but he's not one for that just yet. He's a tough nut and doesn't think he's 11 - Kevin Coleman, trainer.

quotes.race: Bellinter Handicap
quotes.quote: Only Spoofing loves this track and trip. He cut out at Naas last day and back to five today suited him - Kevin Coleman, trainer.

quotes.race: Neptune Investment Management Supports Child Bereavement UK Handicap
quotes.quote: Only Spoofing is improving and came here in good form. He was great today and I think he could win a big one before the end of the year - Kieran O'Neill, jockey.

quotes.race: Troytown Bar Handicap
quotes.quote: He can be very buzzy and went to the start early. Sean (Davis) had ridden him before and gave him a very brave ride. He's great value for his 7lb claim and you'd never think he was a claimer watching that ride. I'd imagine Only Spoofing will be coming back to Ireland before the end of the season - Tim Hogg, assistant to Jedd O'Keeffe, trainer of Only Spoofing.

runners.comment: C&D winner on soft, well beaten when last seen at Navan, watch on debut for new yard
runners.spotlight: Veteran is 5-60 on turf; best at 5f and had a few of these behind when winning over C&D (soft) after a break in October (subsequently disqualified); well beaten at Navan when last seen and probably best watched on debut for new yard.

quotes.race: Troytown Bar Handicap
quotes.quote: He was very brave today and tried very hard. I told Leigh to bounce out and make every post a winning one. Art Of Unity skipped along and you could see him putting his old ears back in the last 100 yards. He tried his heart out. He had 8-6 there and Leigh is a good, strong rider. Leigh and Gary Halpin suit him as they are strong riders but unfortunately Gary couldn't do the weight today and Leigh was a good deputy. He'll go for the Joe McGrath at the Curragh now - Johnny Feane, trainer.

quotes.race: TRI Equestrian Handicap
quotes.quote: Art Of Unity got a nice easy lead and the tailwind helped him, as did the conditions - John Feane, trainer.

quotes.race: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap (Plus 10 Race)
quotes.quote: He ran well the other day and was a little unlucky in getting lonesome on ground that probably was as slow as he wanted. Back to the five furlong trip here was ideal. He had a nice draw, handled the surface well and is a horse who probably doesn't really know how to sprint yet, as he was a little bit lost early doors. He'd probably be a nice little sprinter for Noel next year during the summer on good ground and they should have plenty of fun with him - Colin Keane, jockey

runners.comment: Maiden, best efforts at 6f (inc' on soft), blinkers on for Irish debut, drawn wide
runners.spotlight: Maiden ran well in defeat on multiple occasions for Charlie Johnston including on soft ground; could be on a nice mark for her Irish debut but best form is at 6f and she's drawn wide; wears blinkers for the first time.

runners.comment: Mild promise in AW maidens, best watched down in trip on stable, turf and h'cap debut
runners.spotlight: Mild promise in three AW maidens at 6f-7f for Natalia Lupini; off since December and probably best watched down in trip on stable, turf and handicap debut.

runners.comment: 2-42, out of form during AW winter campaign, below-par turf return latest, revival needed
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-42 (1-28 on turf); didn't look like a winner in waiting during a winter AW campaign and below-par again on return to the turf at Navan (6f, heavy); 5f more suitable but needs a revival.

quotes.race: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
quotes.quote: Never Shout Never is a horse that can progress through the winter months. We will mix it between five and six, more than likely keep him fresh for the next five. We'll see where it takes us then - Stephen Thorne, trainer.

quotes.race: Buy Tickets Online At www.corkracecourse.ie Handicap
quotes.quote: I spoke to Fozzy and Joey Sheridan about Never Shout Never and we were keen on going forward and not pulling out of him, just to get him breathing right. I knew he would get through the ground well as he's a big, strong horse - Jamie Powell, jockey.

runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

prev_owners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.comment: Modest maiden, promise in both handicaps, trouble in running latest, interesting
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden form but has shaped promisingly enough in first two handicaps; hampered and clipped heels when a 4.75l sixth on seasonal return and stable debut at Naas (5f, soft); same mark here and nicely drawn; interesting.

runners.comment: 0-7 on turf, has run well over C&D, pleasing return latest, drop to 5f a plus, player
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; maiden is 0-7 on turf but he has run well in defeat (including over C&D); pleasing return at Navan (6f, heavy) 12 days ago behind Alnofoor and will be suited by the drop back to 5f here; player off just 2lb higher.

runners.comment: C&D winner off 1lb higher in Oct', off since Dec', has gone well fresh, visor goes on
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; C&D winner off 1lb higher in October (Only Spoofing second); below best last few runs at Dundalk and has been off since December but has gone well fresh before; can't discount in first-time visor.

runners.comment: Modest form in maidens and a claimer, cheekpieces on for h'cap debut, watch
runners.spotlight: Hasn't shown much in a couple of 7f Curragh maidens and in a 7f claimer at Dundalk; can only be watched dropped back to 5f in first-time cheekpieces on handicap debut.

prev_owners.owner: Martin W Walsh/Lisgoold Racing Synd/Mrs Mary Louise Mulcahy

runners.comment: On losing run, no sign of drought ending in recent starts, trip a query, others preferred
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner but hasn't got his head in front since September 2022; no signs of the drought ending in recent starts and this trip on the sharp side; others preferred.

quotes.race: William Hill Pick Your Winners Handicap
quotes.quote: Half Nutz is very straightforward but it just didn't fall right for him a few times. I was very happy with the way he ran in Listowel, he didn't get much of a run there. He's a horse that has to be ridden for luck, it didn't happen in Listowel but it happened today - Johnny Murtagh, trainer.

quotes.race: Weatherbys GSB Handicap (Premier Handicap)
quotes.quote: We tried him over five and Wayne got off him the last day and said this was his trip. He's improving. Last year he was running a bit free and just a bit hard on himself but now he's as sweet as a nut. We could try him over seven now if something comes up as he's much easier to ride - trainer Sheila Lavery.

runners.comment: Best run on AW (7f), weakened over 5f on turf bow latest, 1lb wrong, others preferred
runners.spotlight: Best effort came on second handicap start at Dundalk (7f) in January but hasn't replicated that since; weakened over 5f on turf debut at Naas latest and 4lb drop is not enough to tempt (1lb wrong).

runners.comment: Three-time winner in Britain, well treated, sharper for latest, could go well; reserve
runners.spotlight: First reserve; three-time winner in Britain, including twice on turf, but last success came in August 2023; is 8lb below that last win and should strip fitter for his stable debut at Navan; could go well from good draw for local yard if gets a run.

runners.comment: C&D winner, signs of life on reappearance at Navan, on dangerous mark; reserve
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; on losing run since a C&D win on heavy in April 2023; poor form last season but signs of life on reappearance at Navan last month (6f, heavy); on dangerous mark if building on that.

quotes.race: Tifrums Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
quotes.quote: I thought Polar Bear deserved that and has been knocking on the door the whole summer. Shane [Foley] said he jumped out today and ran away with him. He was tanking the whole way. He's in the sales and we'll have to have a conference to see what we're going to do. He had a touch of sore shins and a few little things during the year but has strengthened up a lot now - Jessica Harrington, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He was very tough when winning at Bellewstown this month. He'll mix it between 5f and 6f, but might even stay 7f. 21-04-23

runners.comment: 0-7 on turf, best form on AW, has struggled previous runs on easy ground; reserve
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; maiden is 0-7 on turf; best efforts have come on the AW and has struggled on four previous starts on easy ground; others appeal more.

racecards.verdict: HAPPY HENRY (nap) wasn't far behind Alnofoor last time and he may be able to turn the tables dropped back to 5f on these terms
racecards.betting_forecast: 7/2 Alnofoor, 5/1 Happy Henry, 11/2 Jordan Breeze,  Jazzit, 10/1 Simmering Seas,  Steel Magnolia, 12/1 Baggot Street, 14/1 Only Spoofing, 16/1 Platino Bianco,  Girl Is On Fire,  Iryna's Star, 20/1 Art Of Unity,  Never Shout Never, 25/1 Half Nutz, 28/1 Glen Breeze

runners.comment: C&D winner off 84 in October; in poor form since; contender if he's near his best
runners.spotlight: Gained fifth win of career off 1lb lower over C&D (soft) in October; out of form on AW in November; trailed in last of 14 on Curragh return a fortnight ago; contender if he's near his best with capable 7lb claimer aboard.

runners.comment: Better on the AW but has won on turf; collared close home at Dundalk last time; chance
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; four AW wins; 1-16 on turf; kept very busy on AW in recent months, on latest collared close home when runner-up over 7f off current mark; 7lb claimer takes over from Colin Keane; one to consider.

runners.comment: Regressive on AW of late and well beaten on sole C&D start in October; blinkers go on now
runners.spotlight: Won two 5f novices for Kevin Ryan as a juvenile including on AW at Southwell; has become regressive on AW of late and well beaten on sole C&D start in October; blinkers go on now.

runners.comment: Four-time turf winner won at Curragh around this time last year; player back on grass now
runners.spotlight: Two wins on AW, four on turf; won at the Curragh around this time last year and gained second win of the year at that venue in July off 74 when seeing off Nezeeh by 0.75l; running well in defeat on AW this year and considered back on turf.

quotes.race: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Handicap
quotes.quote: We were delighted to get down here, the Jeep broke down. Cuban Grey was well bought (5,000gns last year out of Murphy/Keady yard) and has now won three for us. He has been consistent of late and hopefully keep improving. I wouldn't mind going for a better race off a light weight - Pat McKenna, trainer, speaking to Racing TV

runners.comment: Well beaten behind Nezeeh on sole C&D try in October when trying to make all
runners.spotlight: One win apiece on turf/AW; well beaten behind Nezeeh on sole C&D try in October when trying to make all; should be all the better for return run at Dundalk last month but others look more likely.

runners.comment: 9-27 return on AW; 0-17 on turf; 8lb lower turf mark but percentage call is to oppose
runners.spotlight: Excellent 9-27 return on AW; 0-17 on turf; seven wins at Dundalk, most recently on yard debut over 6f last month when making all off 75; failed to back that up there ten days ago; races from 8lb lower turf mark plus assistance of 10lb claimer but percentage call is to oppose.

runners.comment: Navan maiden winner likes an ease in the ground; should come on for return run last week
runners.spotlight: Won Navan maiden (5f, yielding) last August and wasn't beaten far next three starts at 5f/6f, the latter two at Dundalk; looked in need of the run on return at Cork on soft last week; ground will suit and one to consider in receipt of 3yo allowance.

runners.breeder: Lynch Bages Ltd & Edge Ridge Ltd
runners.comment: Good form in sprint handicaps last season on varying ground; should improve for return
runners.spotlight: Gained first win at Cork last August (5f, good); ended last season with fine second at the Curragh (5f, heavy), overcoming slow start and headed late on; typically needs reappearance run and much better expected now after Curragh effort eight days ago.

runners.comment: Dual C&D winner on good but the ground might be against her on this occasion
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) on this card last year and gained third win of the year over C&D (good) in July off 69; tailed off at the Curragh on return; ground may be against her on this occasion.

runners.comment: Three wins over 5f in Britain but completely tailed off in two runs for this yard
runners.spotlight: Three wins in Britain at 5f (two on AW); placed at Lingfield over the winter before bought for 14,000gns in February; completely tailed off in two runs for this yard; can only be watched.

quotes.race: At The Races App Market Movers Nursery Handicap
quotes.quote: I was pretty impressed with Mc Loven and he's got a lot of pace. Epsom is Simon's local track and I'm sure he'll target those five-furlong races there next year, but this could be his playground. He doesn't know his job fully yet, but he's got gears - Paddy Bradley, jockey, speaking on Sky Sports Racing.

runners.comment: Never a factor over further trips since joining yard; can't fancy unless market speaks
runners.spotlight: Cork maiden (5f, good) winner who was tailed off last over C&D on final start for Danny Murphy in October; never a factor over further trips since joining this yard; can't fancy unless market speaks; blinkers go back on.

runners.owner: Kildare Racing Syndicate & Kilmichael Racing Syndicate
runners.comment: Front-runner should be hard to beat receiving 3yo allowance and in top order of late
runners.spotlight: Made all for Navan nursery win (5f, soft) last September; good third there next time from 6lb higher; led most of the way when 0.75l third at Naas (5f, soft) on return last month; good chance in receipt of 3yo allowance with the help of rider's 5lb claim.

quotes.race: Aloga Equestrian Nursery Handicap
quotes.quote: The blinkers were a big help. Bay Of Supremacy worked in them the other day and Ben said he gets through the ground really well. There is a 5f race next week at Down Royal and we'll probably let him go again. We'll keep him busy while the ground is soft - Johnny Murtagh, trainer.

racecards.verdict: This could turn into a battle of the 3yos and the front-running BAY OF SUPREMACY is fancied to see off the challenge of Amiata
racecards.betting_forecast: 15/8 Bay Of Supremacy, 4/1 Venetian, 5/1 Amiata, 11/1 Cuban Grey, 12/1 Beauty Queen, 14/1 Asdana, 16/1 Nezeeh,  Mint Man,  Sporting Hero,  Aurora Nova, 25/1 Kilmood Susan, 33/1 Mc Loven

runners.comment: Hasn't shown a pile on the Flat and quiet campaign over hurdles this season; watch market
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins last term over 2m; midfield in 1m2f Curragh handicap off 72 in October; quiet enough hurdles campaign this season, down the field in Listed DRF handicap latest; market will guide back on Flat.

quotes.race: Specialist Group Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I hope Putapoundinthejar will keep improving. He should make a chaser in time, he's a typical Walk In The Park, he can be a little on edge but as soon he's cantering he's very straightforward. He wants better ground and could head to Galway - Tony Martin, trainer, speaking to Racing TV

quotes.race: Molson Coors Beverage Company Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: It has just taken a while for everything to fall into place. Putapoundinthejar is still relatively young and immature. Today's race turned into a great opportunity with Willie's not there. We always thought he was a nice young horse and we still do - Tony Martin, trainer.

runners.owner: P J Morgan & Mrs S L Morgan
runners.comment: Didn't run well on soft at Roscommon on debut; one okay AW run to note; handicap debut
runners.spotlight: Poor debut effort at Roscommon in September when tailed off (1m4f, soft); improved for switch to AW next time when 8l fifth of 14 (10.5f); well beaten there over 1m last month; handicap debut.

runners.comment: Second in two maidens here; makes Flat handicap debut for local yard; watch market
runners.spotlight: Hurdles winner on good; 0-9 on Flat but finished runner-up in two 1m4f maidens at this course; makes Flat handicap debut on return from break for local yard so market should prove to be informative.

runners.comment: Cheltenham handicap hurdle winner; has run good races on the Flat at up to 2m
runners.spotlight: Landed competitive juvenile handicap hurdle at Cheltenham last April on good; good efforts on the Flat at up to 2m after; refused to race on chase debut at Clonmel last month; could figure.

quotes.race: KTDA Fillies' Juvenile Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: That's unbelievable. This was the plan for a long time, I rode a bit in England and I knew the race so brought Lagoon Nebula along with it in mind. She's not the biggest but she's tough - Andrew Kinirons, trainer.

runners.comment: Excellent effort on Wednesday return at Gowran; big chance if her stamina holds out
runners.spotlight: Won Clonmel handicap (9.5f, soft) last autumn and ran a cracker on seasonal reappearance at Gowran (9.5f, soft) on Wednesday when runner-up to a progressive type; player turned out quickly if her stamina holds out.

quotes.race: Suir Blueway Handicap
quotes.quote: I knew Justenzia would keep pulling it out. She'd probably make a nice hurdler, too - Joey Sheridan, rider, speaking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: Half-brother to Group 1 winner Al Riffa; ran well in Flat handicaps last season; likes mud
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to Group 1 winner Al Riffa; never landed a blow in two hurdle races this season but ran well on his last two starts in Flat handicaps, fifth of 18 over 1m4f at Galway and close third at Listowel (1m3f, heavy) in September from 1lb lower; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Best effort yet at the Curragh in October on heavy ground; further improvement likely
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; looked raw when fifth at Killarney on 1m handicap debut but much-improved at the Curragh (1m2f, heavy) in October off 64 when beaten 2l into fourth of 25; further improvement is feasible on return up in distance; cheekpieces.

runners.comment: In brilliant form on the AW but not certain to back that up on turf; isn't dismissed
runners.spotlight: Progressing well on AW for current yard, recording second win at Dundalk last month off 61 before solid third there 10 days ago; not certain to run to that level back on turf but isn't dismissed.

runners.comment: Course winner over hurdles but off the track 632 days; market will reveal expectations
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle at this course in July 2024 before sixth on the Flat at Leopardstown same month; stable in good form and market will reveal expectations returning from 632 days off.

runners.comment: Struggled in 1m course claimer on final 2025 start; tailed off on handicap debut at Navan
runners.spotlight: Struggled in 1m course claimer on final 2025 start; tailed off on handicap debut at Navan 12 days ago; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Better effort on return at Navan (1m4f) when staying on from rear to take sixth of 12
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; didn't show a lot in maidens; soundly beaten on handicap debut at Galway last August; better effort on return at Navan (1m4f) when staying on from rear to take sixth of 12; place chance if she gets away on terms.

runners.comment: German recruit has made no impact in 3 starts for this stable; best form on better ground
runners.spotlight: German recruit has made no impact in three starts for this stable; best form on better ground than this; best watched on return.

runners.comment: 2m AW winner last time out; he's 4lb higher and back in trip, which asks a bit of him
runners.spotlight: Was sporting a tongue-tie for the first time on the AW when staying on best over 2m two weeks ago; he's 4lb higher and back in trip, which asks a bit of him; engaged 7.50 Dundalk on Friday.

quotes.race: John B. Keane (C & G) Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Desert Friend likes it around here. There wasn't much pace on, I was happy enough. He travelled and he jumped well, and he done it really well in the end. We didn't go much of a gallop which suited him down to the ground and he galloped all the way up the straight - Donagh Meyler, jockey.

runners.comment: 0-25 turf record is off-putting and was tailed off behind Baila Conmigo at Dundalk lto
runners.spotlight: Has run well here several times but 0-25 record is off-putting and was tailed off behind Baila Conmigo at Dundalk when last seen; 7lb wrong.

racecards.verdict: SUPERFICIAL had a light hurdles campaign this term and Al Riffa's half-brother is lurking off a dangerous mark returning to the level
racecards.betting_forecast: 4/1 Justenzia,  Superficial,  Obscenity, 6/1 Baila Conmigo,  Desert Friend, 14/1 Radar Ahead, 16/1 Putapoundinthejar,  Good Onya Mate, 20/1 Lagoon Nebula,  Bridgehead,  Mystic Rose, 33/1 Thru The Gap, 50/1 Tara Power, 66/1 Almenfee

runners.comment: Modest debut effort at Dundalk, better back there latest, more needed on turf debut
runners.spotlight: Modest effort on debut at Dundalk (1m4f) but much better there second time up over 10.5f when a 3l fourth of eight; needs to improve again to take this on turf debut.

runners.comment: Talented jumper, promise sole previous start on Flat, watch after mammoth layoff
runners.spotlight: Talented jumper wasn't disgraced on sole previous start on the Flat at Roscommon in July 2023 (RPR 75); however, he's been absent a long time and is likely best watched on debut for new yard.

quotes.race: Killarney Avenue Hotel Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: Captain Conby is a class horse. I said it the day he won his maiden hurdle. His pedigree is all chasers, so I always felt he was going to make a better chaser. He has a high cruising speed and he'll stay. I'll try to keep him in lesser company for as long as I can but he'll get a tilt at a good one - Eamon Sheehy, trainer.

quotes.race: Bar One Racing Rated Novice Hurdle
quotes.quote: Captain Conby is a very good horse I think. He has done very little fast work, he has been trained to progress, and I think there is a lot of improvement still to come from him. He has the engine and definitely has the potential to be a graded horse - Dusty Sheehy, trainer.

quotes.race: Lengthen The Odds With BetVictor Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Captain Conby was always cantering everywhere and hopefully its onwards and upwards. He'll go for a novice hurdle now. It's a while since I've had one as good as him - Dusty Sheehy, trainer.

runners.comment: Winning hurdler, no show at huge odds in two Flat starts on AW, others preferred
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler has been soundly beaten at big prices in two Flat starts at Dundalk; others preferred.

runners.comment: Bumper winner, rated 109 over hurdles, race-fit but likely best watched on Flat debut
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in January 2025; rated 109 over hurdles and race-fit but probably best watched on Flat debut.

runners.comment: Dual-purpose, similar RPRs (mid 60s) in 1m4f maidens at Dundalk, h'caps beckon
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; similar RPRs in mid 60s in two 1m4f Flat runs at Dundalk; will qualify for handicaps after this.

runners.comment: Form of comeback 1m Curragh second has been boosted, longer trip should suit, player
runners.spotlight: Yard in fine form and left previous efforts behind when a 1.75l second of 23 at 66-1 on seasonal reappearance at the Curragh (1m, heavy) and the third has won since; worth a go at this trip on the evidence of that run; he's a player.

runners.comment: Best of four Flat runs came over C&D, handles an ease, rated 77, in the mix
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; best of four runs on the Flat a neck second in a C&D maiden (good) last April when trained by Andrew Kinirons; handles an ease and has gone well fresh; rated 77 and in the mix.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten twice over hurdles and on Flat debut at Dundalk, hard to fancy
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten both runs over hurdles and similar story on Flat debut at Dundalk when 33-1; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Course winner over hurdles, rated 101 in that sphere, watch on belated Flat debut
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner over hurdles including at this venue is rated 101 in that sphere; has had a recent pipe-opener over timber but likely best watched on belated Flat debut.

quotes.race: Book Your Winter Festival Tickets Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: Getting Must Meet Cecil's head in front in the first claimer really helped him and he's enjoying it a lot more now. He was passed up the run-in but battled back, it was a very brave effort. He'll stay going now as long as the ground doesn't get too heavy - Cian Collins, trainer.

quotes.race: Bright Motor Group Claiming Hurdle
quotes.quote: Must Meet Cecil loves good ground and to make plenty of use of him, he's just a big galloper - Cian Collins, trainer.

runners.comment: Vadamos gelding, dam ran twice over hurdles, not much appeal on paper, watch
runners.spotlight: Vadamos gelding; dam ran twice over hurdles, closely related to 2m3f chase winner Toohighforme, half-sister to 3m hurdle winner Let The Show Begin; not much appeal on paper; watch.

runners.comment: Bumper winner, good efforts both maiden hurdles, interesting Flat debutant
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner shaped with promise on both starts in 2m maiden hurdles at Gowran (heavy) in November and Leopardstown (yielding) in December; interesting Flat debutant for top jumps yard.

stable_tour.quote: He ran okay at Gowran in a 2m maiden hurdle. His jumping was a bit deliberate, and he might prefer nicer ground - he'd won a good-ground bumper before that run. 11-11-25

runners.comment: Pulled up when 28-1 in Fairyhouse bumper in December, can only be watched after that
runners.spotlight: 28-1 and pulled up in a Fairyhouse bumper in December; yard in form but can only be watched after that.

runners.comment: Rated 74, promise all three starts last season, looks the second string on rider bookings
runners.spotlight: One of two for yard; rated 74; promise all three starts last season and was beaten just 1.75l on final start of 2025 at the Curragh (1m4f, heavy) in November; could go well but jockey arrangements suggest she's the second string.

runners.comment: Modest form over hurdles, off since October, best watched on Flat debut
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three starts over hurdles; off since October and best watched on Flat debut.

runners.comment: Rated 76, placed in four of five starts (inc' over C&D), ground fine, chance
runners.spotlight: Rated 76; generally consistent filly has placed in four of five starts in maidens at 1m3f-1m4f (including one over C&D); below best on most recent start at Listowel in first-time cheekpieces which are quickly dispensed with; easy ground fine and she has a chance.

runners.comment: Smart form in 2024, top-rated at 87, should stay 1m4f on breeding, preferred by Lee
runners.spotlight: Smart form in 2024 included a 4.75l fourth of 8 in a Group 3 at the Curragh (1m, good); ran well on debut on yielding at Galway (7f); dam side of pedigree suggests she'll stay 1m4f, trainer can ready one and she's preferred by Billy Lee; top-rated at 87; obvious chance if she's fit.

runners.comment: Triple-figure odds for all ten starts and ran accordingly, impossible to fancy; reserve
runners.spotlight: First reserve; triple-figure odds for all ten starts and has run accordingly; impossible to fancy.

quotes.race: bet365 Two Year Old Trophy Conditions Stakes (IRE Incentive Race) (Colts & Geldings)
quotes.quote: It didn't look like a bad race on paper and it was a good, solid performance. Bombay Bazaar is getting better. He's a home bred who missed out on going to the sales and he'll improve. The owner will be keen to go (to Royal Ascot). There's no reason for him not to - Richard Fahey, trainer.

quotes.race: IRE-Incentive It Pays To Buy Irish Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
quotes.quote: The Thirsk run did Bombay Bazaar the world of good, he was very green that day then did his best work at the end. He picked up well here - Robin O'Ryan, trainer's assistant, speaking to Racing TV.

stable_tour.quote: He had a setback at the start of last season but came back and nearly won the Hungerford Stakes, so he goes well fresh. He could start in the Listed King Richard III Stakes over seven furlongs at  Leicester and needs fast ground to be at his best. He's a solid Listed/Group 3 horse and could win a nice race. 13-04-22

quotes.race: Darley Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: The grass gallops were closed in Newmarket, we were training on all-weathers - you go and run on deep ground and Mostabshir didn't like it. We get him back on the first summer ground we've had this year and it's a different result.  When a jockey tells you they've quicken twice, it's worth noting. It was a good performance, he was giving 6lb to the opposition. We're in a complete muddle now, we don't know whether we're going for the Britannia or if the handicapper's going to make it impossible and we go in the deep end - John Gosden, joint-trainer.

quotes.race: Arabian Radio Network ARN (Handicap) (Dirt)
quotes.quote: The one draw was very important, I thought, but I had plenty of horse to hold my position. Welcome Dream showed a lot of speed and stayed well to the line and I struggled to pull him up. He'll get further - Pat Dobbs, jockey.

prev_owners.owner: One More Moment Of Madness & Partner

stable_tour.quote: A nice, scopey horse, he ran at Wolverhampton two weeks ago but nothing went right. The course probably wasn't ideal and he'll be better on a more galloping track. He should also get a mile and a quarter. 17-04-24

quotes.race: National Racehorse Week British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I like Wanees and have always liked him. Mentally he's been a bit soft, but he came out of Newbury really well and just needs racing. We'll see about plans, but he'll stay further next year and he handled that ground, but Le Havre's can like a bit of cut - Charlie Hills, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: We ran him in the Lincoln but he never went a yard for whatever reason - probably the ground. He's been fine since and has trained nicely. We'll give him an extra week or two to get over that and then draw up a plan, which is likely to include smart mile handicaps, but I'm optimistic he'll get further. 17-04-23

He has a healthy strike-rate with four wins from nine starts, the most recent in a mile handicap at Haydock last autumn. I have to say he has disappointed in his two starts this season and we're going to try cheekpieces with him in the Royal Hunt Cup on Wednesday. He just hasn't been finishing off his races and it could be that having spent a lot of time teaching him to settle he has possibly settled too much. I've been fortunate enough to win the Royal Hunt Cup twice and if this fellow reacts positively to the headgear he could be a live contender. 21-06-23

quotes.race: Time Test EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
